description.short_caption: Ulcerative and crusted lesions on the perioral region.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows multiple ulcerative lesions with yellowish crusting and erythematous bases on the perioral region, including the chin and lower lip. The lesions vary in size and appear to have a moist, exudative surface. The surrounding skin shows mild erythema. The distribution suggests a localized infectious or inflammatory process.
